method: Hash-verified complete scan of canonical General (talked) calls and the recording sample; deterministic summary/turn rules.

summary_definitions.label: Callback request
summary_definitions.meaning: The summary mentions busy/unavailable, calling again or rescheduling.
summary_definitions.synthetic_example: The seller asks to call tomorrow.
summary_definitions.caution: A bot offering to call again also matches; no time has necessarily been agreed.

summary_definitions.label: Contact suppression
summary_definitions.meaning: The text contains a stop-calling or number-removal phrase.
summary_definitions.synthetic_example: The seller says: please do not call.
summary_definitions.caution: A bot quoting a policy can match. Confirm the actor, and honor actual stop requests immediately.

summary_definitions.label: Executive continuity
summary_definitions.meaning: The text mentions an existing executive or previous contact/meeting.
summary_definitions.synthetic_example: The seller says they already spoke with an executive.
summary_definitions.caution: The phrase alone does not verify which executive, when, or whether a meeting happened.

summary_definitions.label: Explanation depth
summary_definitions.meaning: The summary includes explain, clarify, confusion or did-not-understand wording.
summary_definitions.synthetic_example: The seller asks the agent to explain the package.
summary_definitions.caution: An agent saying they explained something also matches; this is not a learning-style score.

summary_definitions.label: Language preference
summary_definitions.meaning: The narrow legacy rule looks for prefer/speak/switch/continue followed by Hindi, English or Tamil.
summary_definitions.synthetic_example: The seller asks to continue in Hindi.
summary_definitions.caution: Other languages and phrasings are missed. A bot's language proposal is not a seller preference.

summary_definitions.label: Price concern
summary_definitions.meaning: The summary contains price/pricing, cost, budget or payment.
summary_definitions.synthetic_example: The seller asks what the package costs.
summary_definitions.caution: Even 'price was not an issue' matches the legacy chart. This is a price mention, not proven resistance.

summary_definitions.label: Service issue
summary_definitions.meaning: The text contains refund, complaint, unresolved or service issue.
summary_definitions.synthetic_example: The seller mentions an unresolved complaint.
summary_definitions.caution: A resolved complaint or agent reassurance can match; review the full context.

rules.label: Stop/contact refusal
rules.pattern: \b(do not call|don't call|stop calling|remove (?:my|the) number|dobara (?:phone|call) mat|call mat)\b
rules.action: Confirm and honor contact restrictions; do not rebut a stop request.

rules.label: Language/understanding barrier
rules.pattern: \b(language barrier|(?:could not|couldn't|did not|didn't|unable to) understand|(?:spoke|speaking|responded) (?:only )?in (?:Gujarati|Telugu|Tamil|Kannada|Bengali|Marathi)|hindi mein|english mein|samajh nahi|samajh nahin)\b
rules.action: Confirm the preferred language and use a supported speaker; ask one short confirmation.

rules.label: Identity/authority unresolved
rules.pattern: \b(wrong (?:number|person)|not the (?:owner|right person)|unable to confirm|not able to confirm|could not confirm|owner (?:was |is )?(?:not available|unavailable)|galat number|malik nahi)\b
rules.action: Confirm business and decision-maker identity before a package pitch; do not assume the recipient is the seller.

rules.label: Existing service problem
rules.action: Acknowledge the issue, capture a concrete example and route an accountable follow-up before selling.

rules.label: Busy/callback timing
rules.pattern: \b(busy|unavailable|call (?:back|later)|callback|reschedul\w*|asked (?:the agent )?to wait|baad me|baad mein|abhi time nahi|time nahi hai)\b
rules.action: Ask permission for a short call or agree a specific callback window; preserve the seller's answer.

rules.label: Price/value question
rules.action: Ask which outcome matters and explain only catalog-backed benefits and prices; do not invent ROI.

rules.label: Existing executive/meeting
rules.action: Confirm the prior executive and agreed next action; avoid duplicate meeting requests.

rules.label: Interest or need declined
rules.pattern: \b(not interested|no interest|not required|no (?:need|requirement)|refused|declined|not looking|nahi chahiye|nahin chahiye|zarurat nahi|interest nahi)\b
rules.action: Clarify once if welcome, then respect the refusal; do not reinterpret silence as interest.

rules.label: Explanation or information needed
rules.action: Answer one specific question in plain language, then check understanding before asking for a meeting.

rules.label: No usable seller response
rules.pattern: \b(no response|without (?:any |a )?(?:further )?response|did not respond|didn't respond|no (?:further )?(?:conversation|discussion)|before (?:the )?(?:lead|seller) could respond|immediately after (?:the )?(?:greeting|introduction))\b
rules.action: Review audio and connection evidence; there may be no actual sales conversation to rebut.

rules.label: Conversation ended early
rules.action: Inspect the ending and turn coverage before attributing rejection; offer a consented retry only when appropriate.

rules.label: No clear next step recorded
rules.action: Ask one explicit next-step question; distinguish willingness, booked time and completed meeting.

recording_scope.audio_note: 5,000 recording memberships; no audio was fetched or listened to in this study. Supplied role-labelled turns are machine transcripts, not newly validated recordings.

limitations: Association, not causal uplift or proof of which strategy works best.
Calls and sellers are different denominators; persona cohorts overlap and repeat sellers.
Broad lexical candidates can miss negation, actor nuance and unsupported languages.
Turn conflicts are excluded, never arbitrarily resolved. Historical labels remain unchanged.
Observed bot response does not establish a successful rebuttal; no validated resolution rate is available.
